column1: # Every original tests/test-*.sh suite, the behaviour it owned, and what now proves it.
# A go-test row is proved by Go package tests. A black-box row is proved by running
# the shell suite itself against one built binary, which is what tests/run.sh
# builds and runs; those suites must neither source lib/*.sh nor execute
# Rows for deleted suites stay as the record of where their behaviour went.
